parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs.

parameters.name: BlockType
parameters.description:
The blocking type. Valid values:

*   blacklist
*   whitelist

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: integers from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-stream-location-block --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name stream --block-type blacklist --page-size 5 --page-num 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeStreamLocationBlock --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName stream --PageSize 5 --PageNum 1 --DomainName 'example.com' --BlockType blacklist --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName liveApp0000
